summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.38/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.38 a gallon across Wisconsin as of October 27, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 30¢ higher than a week ago, 15¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.67 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($4.03) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.64).
